name: Sleeping Bear in the Red Land

steps.name: Sleeping Bear in the Red Land (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Chrysien] in "Mars", go to [Baldrick] in "Phobos".

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Haam… . Hello, Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chrisien, you look sleepy today too. Haam… . I think this yawn is somehow contagious.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: But what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wanted to come to Phobos one more time.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Do you have any clothes you would like to have repaired or requested from me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, no.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: It's unfortunate, but there's nothing we can do... . Haam… . But since you came to me, I can’t just leave.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Did you see Uncle Baldrick by any chance?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick, do you have a favor to ask?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Wow, thanks for noticing!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Uncle Baldrick will be eating and sleeping richly like a red bear. Like hibernating!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, is this such a request that I have to wake up a sleeping bear?!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: … yes… .

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Wow… , It’s no big deal. There's no need to be scared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He must be the one who makes a deadly attack saying he is happy to meet you... .

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: There is a way. Before you wake me up, you can tell me that Pionia has prepared the meat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a fairly primitive method.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what can I do?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I gave him a few shirts, but they became a mess after a while. So now I've given up and only occasionally repair the clothes I'm wearing.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Since it’s been a while since you had your clothes repaired, you can just ask him to come to Mars and get them repaired.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: If you call out ‘Designer Teacher’ loudly outside, please tell them to leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Designer teacher?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I'm embarrassed to tell you, but my dream is to become a famous clothes designer. Now I'm studying to become like that.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: (Chrisien’s eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I heard that there are many such designers on the Freios continent. If I get the chance, I want to go there once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much because everything will be fine. If things go well in the future, I will become your customer.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Yes, sir… .

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I, %s, feel better, so I'm going to go to sleep for a bit.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, I'm sleepy too. Then shall we go to Baldrick?

steps.name: Sleeping Bear in the Red Land (2)
steps.objective: Defeat the monsters in the “Cradle of Illusions” and obtain <Flower of the Cradle>. Then report to [Baldrick] in “Phobos”.

lines.text: (Baldrick is sleeping in a quiet place, moving freely. It seems he just ate, so there are empty dishes around him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's really a red bear preparing for hibernation... . But should I wake Baldrick or not? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, as Chrysien said… . Hey Baldrick, Peonia is meat… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Meat is good. It's baked, right? No soup or anything like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's real. Baldrick wakes up right away.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What about meat?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's because Chrysien said that Baldrick would wake up right away if he said this.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I can't help it. I have no choice but to get rich next time... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Seeing as you came, I guess Chrysien asked me to call you designer teacher again in front of Mars, right?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's a hassle to fix clothes... . But you can't keep wearing messy clothes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's because I'm carrying something heavy with my cloth clothes.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That's right. But I can't help it. I have to live.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do I have to live?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Even though I am called a superhuman, I am also basically a human being. So, I have to live. If I die, someone else will take this annoying power.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: How can I die knowing what the person who takes it will do? It's mine, so I have to take good care of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this similar to what Jiscard said?...)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Oh, didn't I tell you? Seeing the expression on his face that said he had no idea, I guess it was other guys talking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I just received strength from God.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Yeah? Aside from Grandpa Adkina because he's a dragon, there's Jiscard's brother who is human, the Shinik kid, Medea and Io ladies... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Everyone lives because they can't die. I missed my time to die. If I don't live like this, will I go crazy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe that’s why Yu-ran stopped crying….)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: The kid said he had his clothes repaired, so I guess I should go sometime. Wouldn’t you like it if I called you designer teacher as you wish?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: By the way, will the little one be okay? I hope people don't get ostracized in the village because of me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You care about Chrysien.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's hard for Pioneer and the little ones to make a living, but they also take care of my meals. Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, rice… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: After all, meat is what fills your stomach. I heard it's amazing that the little boy likes clothes more than meat. Huh, now that I think about it!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Brother, if you are bored, please do me a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? I'm not bored... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Get a bunch of white flowers from the cradle. They all look the same to me, so I don't know if I can get something right if my brother saves it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Flowers?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Okay, then I'll sleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I was supposed to sleep, but you disturbed my sleep. Did you hear it from Jiscard’s brother? Can you spar with me for 3 days and nights without rest?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll just come back.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: If I don't wake up, say 'meat'. It's better if it's real meat.
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Baldrick lies down and falls asleep.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whoa, I need to get back quickly and eat something. Meat?)

steps.name: Sleeping Bear in the Red Land (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lilith] in “Cradle of Illusions” and obtain <Succubus Velvet Dress>. Then report to [Chrysien] in “Mars”.

lines.text: (Baldrick is curled up and sleeping. He is obviously asleep, but he feels strong energy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Compared to other superhumans, it feels more wild.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick, I'm here. I said it wouldn't happen if I did this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meat… ?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Did you bring flowers instead of meat?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baldrick, what did you ask me to bring this for?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This flower is used to remove evil energy from objects. As soon as my teacher first saw me, he called me a devil and hit me in the face with this flower.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn’t the example completely different?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, if a devil-like guy is like this, he's a reformed person, so that's it.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let’s see♬ The teacher once said that if you take off all the petals and wear them on your body, it’s done♬
(Baldrick puts the petal into %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do this to me... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Now, put this under your clothes and go back into the crib.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Go and find the dress left behind by the dream demon named Lilith. I heard that high-ranking monks bring extra clothes with them when they go out.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Lilith would probably have brought some pretty high-end items. You will be able to find it this time too.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Don't come to me as soon as you find it, but bring it straight to Chrysien. It will help him study. And tell them that it is a substitute for meat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, it's the devil's clothes. Is it okay if I bring it to you?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Brother, don’t worry too much. This flower is not an ordinary flower.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: These are the flowers that Grandpa Adkina brought from Lapier to mourn when his teacher passed away.  It blooms and dies again and the number increases... .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Even though a long time has passed, it is still a very effective flower. There are not many people who know. ha ha ha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If so, I feel reassured.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I asked you for a favor, but I feel like I'm taking advantage of you, so I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. It's okay as long as it's not sparring.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That's a bit disappointing... . Then please. I need to sleep some more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then take a good rest. See you later.
(Baldrick sees the back of %s going to the cradle of illusions and lies down on the floor.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Heh… .

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Because he's a fun guy.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Is it time for everyone to come now? If you wake me up, I will wake up then.
(Chrysien is dozing off while holding the cloth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chrysien still seems sleepy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's interesting. When I first found it, I felt like a succubus, but now it feels sacred because of the petals.)

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Hmm… . I'm sleepy. %s? Didn't you go to Uncle Baldrick?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went there. Here's something for you.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: What is it… ?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Huh!
(Chrysien’s eyes, which always had sleepy eyes, became clearer.)

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: No, this!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: What is this? The highest quality velvet fabric that was said to be obtained through a method known only to the long-dead kingdom of Howl!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Super sensuous design that maximizes the charm of the wearer!!

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: It smells like a beautiful rose, right? Amazingly sophisticated and beautiful... .

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: This wasn't originally in Eastland, right? That something this good suddenly appeared... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, well... . It's difficult to give details, but it's okay. Because I found it with the power of the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And Baldrick said he was giving it to me instead of meat.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Ah… . Just the meat that came from Uncle Baldrick... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much meat do you eat? .

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Hehe, that's what it says. Then I will receive it well. I was just wondering if there was a new costume worth referring to, hehe... .

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Thanks to you two, I was able to get a little closer to my dream.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Ah, Adventurer. There's something I'd like to ask. Have you ever met a female superhuman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a few minutes. But why is that?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I heard they were cool people. I want to give them my clothes and have them stand in a fashion show.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I heard that all three of us have different body types and styles, so I'm going to try to design one to suit them. Hehehe. One of them might be easy.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Uncle Baldrick said that I was similar in that I was a kid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say something like that in front of someone, you'll get scolded... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chrisien, then work hard. I will support you.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer! Please come visit Mars often.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Hehehe… . Then, let’s put it on P.O. first. Because you look good in everything.
